description: Create a Seedream task on RunAPI (decompose layers). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

image_url.description: Exactly one public PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, or GIF image URL; HEIC and HEIF are unsupported. Maximum 30 MB, 262,144-36,000,000 total pixels, and aspect ratio 1:16-16:1. Declared type: string.

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

output_format.description: Base image format. Separated layers are PNG. Declared type: string. Known values: "png", "jpeg".

prompt.description: Optional instructions describing which elements to separate. Declared type: string.

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: decompose_layers
